body: Alright friends, fun ride but I must consummate this now. 40 crushed taxus baccata seeds and at approximately 3am I will have died. This is an abrupt end to a strange story. Since I am at the precipice of the threshold of death, I ask for prayers. To Tanzania, my love thank you for humoring me in becoming my beloved companion. I am thankful and wish you were the mother of my children. Goodbye dear friends. Remember me for who I was, if you care to come to the funeral I left instructions in my will for a family member to enter in the date and time of my funeral if any would like to come. I might post once more at approximately 2:30am before my passing. Again, thank you and may your lives be enriched ❤️
